messages:
Rhea K: Heads-up from veridian-embed-v3 bring-up. ran float16 vs int4-hybrid (per-channel for top-k dims, per-tensor rest). Short-tail/query-intent set shows recall@1 drop ~7pt; longer wiki queries fine. posting the minimal eval table and a few examples.

Tom B: ouch. paste the numbers + example anchor->nn lists pls.

Rhea K: quick paste:
```
model: veridian-embed-v3
quant: int4-hybrid (topk=64 per-channel)
dataset: shorttail-intent-holdout (n=30k)
recall@1: 0.542 (float16: 0.612)
recall@5: 0.703 (float16: 0.748)
recall@10: 0.764 (float16: 0.803)
MRR: 0.631 (float16: 0.682)
silhouette: 0.141 (float16: 0.196)
avg_cos(nn1): 0.66 (f16:0.72)
median_rank_shift: 3
frac_top1_diff: 0.128
KL_nn_dist: 0.21
```

Yasmeen S: interesting that KL is high. did you try keeping top-64 dims in float16 and quant rest? sounds similar to your hybrid but curious about thresholding.

Rhea K: hybrid already keeps topk dims higher precision; this profile was top64 float16 + rest int4-perchannel. I also tried top128 and saw recall@1 go to 0.575 but cost jump was nontrivial.

Tom B: can you dump raw dot products pre-L2 and post-L2? sometimes the L2 step hides anisotropic scaling and changes rank order.

Rhea K: yes will dump. preliminary note: a few anchors had nn1 flipping because a single dimension got quantized to edge value causing ~0.15 cosine delta. looks like subtoken-heavy queries where embedding head sparsely populates certain dims.

embed-bot: Registry event: veridian-embed-v3 registered (trial) at 2026-03-20T11:40:00Z; quant_profiles=[int4-hybrid,int6-perchannel,float16]. CI eval queued id=ci-28654.

Yasmeen S: suggested ablations: (1) per-channel bias-correction fit on small calibration set (2) tiny rank-1 residual stored as u*v per-shard (3) index-time re-whitening using float16 calibration stats. Also try unit-sphere normalization after residual.

Rhea K: plan: run (1)+(3) today on staging, collect swapped-pairs and pairwise cosine-delta histogram. If residual (2) looks promising I'll test rank-1 patch that adds ~8% storage.

Tom B: also run ef_search and probe-size ablation on HNSW; sometimes quant changes neighborhood curvature and ef_search needs bump. try ef=[64,200,500] with ef_construction 300.

Rhea K: noted. I'll kick off jobs and upload artifacts to the onboarding bucket under /veridian/v3/int4-hybrid/{run_ts}. Sharing links when ready. leaning to keep float16 for short-query SLOs until we prove recovery. :mag:
